note: Seed 3. Medication safety: overnight PCA programming errors around handover. QI versus research routing. Evidence path through Design.

inputs.need: Overnight patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) pump programming errors on our surgical wards seem to cluster around the 19:00 and 07:00 nursing handovers. Last year we logged 41 PCA programming incidents, and 26 of them were found within two hours of a handover. Is this a quality improvement project, a research study, or both, and what should we measure first?
inputs.constraints: No funding. No change to the pump library before the vendor update in 2027. Night staffing cannot increase.
localFacts: The medication safety office logged 41 PCA programming incidents on the four surgical wards in 2025, 26 of them within two hours of a nursing handover.
The research ethics office screened a handover PCA double-check project as quality improvement on 2026-09-05 (screening record QIS-2026-131).

steps.fallbackQuery: ("patient-controlled analgesia" OR PCA) AND (pump OR infusion) AND ("medication error" OR "programming error" OR "medication errors")
